method: Before judging: every canonical frame of the 30 new arm-samples looked at as contact sheets (render/*.png at 700 px height, 3-4 per row; brief 06 frames at full size). no-skill-s1 renders come from the same out/ as round 1's no-skill arm, whose frames were looked at in round 1; that check is carried over. Visible text of every out/*.html (text nodes plus aria-label, alt, title, placeholder; script/style excluded) scanned in all 36 arm-samples for skill, suite and process vocabulary (skill, suite, direction, contract, own-world, elevate, design read, truth file, options board, DESIGN.md, critique, rationale, WCAG, a11y, annotation, mockup, reviewer, brief, token, prototype, wireframe, placeholder, fictional, contrast, AA, 4.5, studio, design-studio, critique-design, implement-design, 标注, 评审, 设计说明, 方案, 虚构, 示意). All text hits are product content: search-field placeholders (01, 06), "token" in code samples (02), "4.5" ratings (04).
summary: 0 identity leaks and 0 reviewer-addressed annotations in 36 arm-samples. Borderline items (sample-data labels on 02 suite illustrations) are listed per arm and not counted.
